subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — Starlit AI / Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@starlit.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — Starlit AI / Redwood Inference

Hi Lucas —

Great to meet you last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) and align on owners and timelines for the evaluation. Thanks for the interest in Redwood — we think we can get you a representative end-to-end evaluation (baseline -> pilot) in ~4–6 weeks if we align scope and test assets this week.

Attached: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (MAP template) and eval_plan_template.md (sketch of evaluation steps).

High-level proposed milestones (we can tighten on the call):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm stakeholders, access, and success criteria
- Week 1: Test dataset ingest + baseline perf run (small set)
- Week 2–3: Scale throughput tests + quality checks (reranking/eval sets)
- Week 4: Pilot rollout + cost/latency readout

Ask: can you confirm who will be the technical owner on your side (network, S3 access, runtime validation)? I’ve CC’d Hannah (SE) and Neha (ML engineer) — Hannah will lead the hands-on tech sync and Neha will support model-specific evaluation (quantization/latency tradeoffs).

Proposed next step: 30-min technical sync next Tue/Wed. Please share a preferred time and any network/security contacts. If you prefer, Hannah can run an initial smoke run during the call.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — Starlit AI / Redwood Inference

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the templates. Starlit is aligned to move forward. Tech owner on our side will be Daniel Park (cc’d below) — he’ll handle S3 access, network peering checks, and host the test harness. Procurement will loop in separately for contract language, but we don’t anticipate blockers.

Daniel — can you confirm availability for a 30-min tech sync next Wed (11/25) around 10am PT or Thu (11/26) morning? Also, we’ll plan to provide a small sample dataset and a brief network diagram prior to the call.

Lucas
Head of Product | Starlit AI
lucas.chen@starlit.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@starlit.ai>, Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@starlit.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:46:00-08:00
Subject: SE intro + proposed tech sync agenda — Starlit eval

Hi Daniel / Lucas —

Thanks Lucas — hi Daniel, nice to e-meet you. I’m Hannah, Solutions Engineer on the Redwood team; I’ll run the technical side of the MAP and walk your team through an end-to-end smoke run. A few quick logistics and a proposed 30-min agenda below so we can make the first sync actionable: 

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: Introductions & evaluation goals (baseline perf + quality targets)
- 5–12m: Access & network checklist (S3 paths, IP allowlist, peering options)
- 12–22m: Demo smoke run plan (sample inference, KV cache, latency measurement)
- 22–28m: Success criteria + data for scoring (what to send, formats)
- 28–30m: Action items & owners (MAP responsibilities)

Pre-reqs we’ll need from you before the sync:
- Small sample dataset (CSV/JSON) or short S3 path we can pull from (<= 10k tokens total)
- Network diagram (NAT/VPC/subnets) and any egress restrictions
- Point of contact for provisioning (IAM or temporary creds is fine)

Attachments we’ll bring from our side: quick smoke-run script, eval metric checklist, and a small reference dataset. I’ve attached a sample payload file here for quick validation.

Let me know which time works — Wed 11/25 10:00 PT looks good on my calendar now. If that doesn’t work, Tue 11/24 afternoon is also possible.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

[attachment: testdata-sample.tar.gz (application/gzip)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@starlit.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@starlit.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SE intro + proposed tech sync agenda — Starlit eval

Hannah / Jordan —

Thanks — Wed 11/25 10:00 PT works for our team. I’ve created a tentative calendar invite and shared a folder with the items you requested:
- GCS link: gs://starlit-eval/sample-dataset/ (contains sample.json, ~3k tokens)
- Network diagram attached: starlit_network_diagram.pdf
- IAM: I’ll provision a temporary read-only S3 role and share ARNs in the calendar invite notes.

We’ll also include a short README in the shared folder with the minimal evaluation harness steps. If you want us to run any particular prompt shapes or request/response size distributions, tell us and we’ll include them.

Looking forward to the call.

—
Daniel Park
Engineering Lead | Starlit AI
daniel.park@starlit.ai
